name: NuGet Gallery API
tagline: Official .NET package protocol for search, metadata, and package content.
description: Public NuGet Gallery HTTP API (v3) for the primary .NET package registry: service index discovery, package search, registration metadata, package content downloads, and related resources used by the nuget client and tooling.

auth.details: Public read (search/metadata/content) needs no auth. Publishing and account APIs use NuGet API keys (X-NuGet-ApiKey) from nuget.org.

use_cases: resolve latest package version by package id
download nupkg content for a version
